children: Brand strategist and communications lead with eight years of experience helping independent businesses find a clear voice and connect with their audiences. I combine research, editorial thinking, and collaborative leadership to build thoughtful brands, and I am seeking a senior strategy role with a purpose-led team.
Led positioning and messaging projects for 12 independent brands, from discovery workshops to launch.
Created a shared strategy framework that shortened project handovers by 25%.
Mentored three writers and partnered with designers to deliver cohesive brand experiences.
Built an editorial programme across email, social, and web, growing newsletter readership by 38%.
Introduced audience research and content guidelines used by a six-person marketing team.
Coordinated a brand refresh across customer communications, packaging, and digital channels.
Wrote campaign copy, website content, and editorial articles for lifestyle and culture clients.
Developed a reusable briefing process that reduced revision rounds and improved creative alignment.
Brand positioning · Audience research · Workshop facilitation · Campaign planning
Copywriting · Editorial strategy · Stakeholder management · Creative team leadership
